title: Make Company B publication recovery transactional and bounded
objective: Starting from the clean B-TASK-003 queue implementation, fix the complete post-PASS publication/lifecycle recovery contract identified by PM inspection and the failed B-TASK-004 Codex review. A rerun may resume remote publication only from a validated PASS/DONE worker result and valid evidence; no partial lifecycle failure may strand an Issue or leave stale automatic-recovery eligibility.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve visible fail-closed company-b:blocked status for recoverable publication failures, but make a later invocation resume only when saved queue state and authoritative worker state match the same task/branch and the worker state is status PASS, phase DONE, reviewVerdict PASS.
Blocked Issues with absent, malformed, mismatched, non-PASS worker state, or missing/invalid fixed-test or Codex evidence must never be automatically resumed.

Recovery after a validated PASS/DONE worker result must never re-invoke Claude implementation or Codex review; it may retry only remote branch, Draft PR, exact-head evidence, and lifecycle publication.

Make the final running/blocked -> done lifecycle completion recoverable as one bounded state machine: if label mutation succeeds but the completion comment fails, a subsequent run must deterministically discover and finish or safely block the same Issue rather than strand it as undiscoverable done.
Any evidence-validation failure must explicitly revoke/clear automatic publication-recovery eligibility before or while moving the Issue to its safe visible state; stale eligibility must not survive.
Queued tasks that merely have an existing runtime, without a matching saved recovery state proving a prior validated PASS/DONE result, must still fail closed.
The production queue default BaseRef must be company-b/operational-v0.1 rather than the bootstrap branch.
Update QUEUE_PROTOCOL.md so the documented recovery state machine exactly matches executable behavior, including partial final lifecycle failures and evidence invalidation.

Extend deterministic tests to simulate/contract-check: publication failure -> blocked recovery; partial final label success/comment failure; invalid evidence after prior publication failure; rejection of non-PASS/mismatched recovery state; no Claude/Codex reinvocation during publication-only recovery; and operational default BaseRef.
Do not broaden scope into scheduler/heartbeat.
Existing pytest suite plus updated queue tests must pass.
Final independent Codex review must return PASS.
